meta.title: Week 3 (Sept 27–28, 2026) QB Stream Report — Connor's 8-team Sleeper league
meta.as_of: 2026-09-25 (Fri practice reports; lines Fox/Covers 9/23; stats through Wk2, ATL/GB through Wk3)
notes: Per-QB stats through Wk2 (ATL/GB through the Thursday game). Pass first downs = NFL.com '1st' column.
dvp_pct = FootballDB standard QB points allowed/g by the opponent vs the 32-team average (heavily shrunk, capped ±12%).
opp_comp_allowed / opp_sack_rate / opp_int_rate from NFL.com team defense passing (2 games).
Big-play pass bonuses set to 0 (unconfirmed). Pass TD = 6 (assumed same as other TDs).
ROS uses each team's remaining schedule (fftoday + FootballDB, byes cross-checked vs NFL.com) and the same QB DvP table.

candidates.name: Josh Allen
candidates.notes: Best efficiency profile in the pool: 67% comp, 45% first-down rate, 4 rush TD. Chargers allow 70% completions. Almost certainly rostered.

candidates.name: C.J. Stroud
candidates.notes: Volume king (94 att) but in THIS scoring that's the problem: 37 incompletions in two games = −37. Colts D allows 118 rating and 30.5 pts/g to QBs, Ward Q — the matchup carries him. Nico Collins OUT.

candidates.name: Tyler Shough
candidates.notes: 69% completions on 45 att/g, 30 first downs (most in the pool). Sacked 8 times. Raiders D: 8 sacks, 3 INT, 55.6% comp allowed — tough.

candidates.name: Aaron Rodgers
candidates.notes: 5.2 Y/A, 59% comp, 20 FD on 79 att: the worst efficiency here. Bengals D 8 sacks. Avoid.

candidates.name: Michael Penix Jr.
candidates.notes: PLAYED Thu: 18/25, 256, 1/1. Sample is one game — projection leans on priors. Next: @NO Wk4.

candidates.name: Jared Goff
candidates.notes: 67.5% comp, 6 TD / 0 INT, 29 FD. Jets D: 57% comp allowed, 285 yds in 2 games, 6 sacks — best pass D he's seen. Rostered.

candidates.name: Bryce Young
candidates.notes: 8.9 Y/A, 6 TD, 39% first-down rate, 10 completions of 20+. Browns allow 112 rating. Best true streamer in the pool. Bye Wk5.

candidates.name: Patrick Mahomes
candidates.notes: Miami has ZERO sacks and allows 79% completions. 11-pt favorite may cap volume late. Rostered.

candidates.name: Marcus Mariota
candidates.notes: First start for Daniels (elbow). One relief appearance of data. Seattle allows 59.0 rating, 0 completions of 20+, 4 INT on 61 att — the worst possible spot.

candidates.name: Joe Burrow
candidates.notes: 68% comp but a pick-six already and 5 sacks Wk2. Steelers allow 7.0 QB pts/g (best in NFL), 3 INT, 59% comp. Sit if you can.

candidates.name: Dak Prescott
candidates.notes: 74% comp, 43% FD rate, 2 sacks in 2 games — elite for this format. Ravens allow 71% comp. Highest total of the week (52.5).

candidates.name: Geno Smith
candidates.notes: 71% comp, 0 INT, but only 1 TD and a 28% FD rate. Lions allow 37 QB pts/g (worst) with both starting safeties out. 6.5-pt dog = volume.

candidates.name: Jacoby Brissett
candidates.notes: 5.7 Y/A, 4 FD in Wk2. 49ers D allows 8.5 QB pts/g even without Bosa. 8.5-pt dog. No.

candidates.name: Case Keenum
candidates.notes: 38-year-old emergency starter, hasn't played since 2023 — pure league-average prior. Eagles allow 57% comp. Monday night. Williams/Bagent both OUT.

candidates.name: Daniel Jones
candidates.notes: 66% comp, 2 sacks, but 2 INT and 6.1 Y/A. Texans allow 117 rating, 9 completions 20+; Clowney OUT.

candidates.name: Jalen Hurts
candidates.notes: Bears allow 8.7 Y/A. 4.5-pt favorite on the road Monday vs a Keenum-led offense = positive script. Rostered.

candidates.name: Baker Mayfield
candidates.notes: 71% comp but 7 sacks and 3 lost fumbles. Vikings D: 8 sacks, 53% comp allowed, 9 completions 20+ allowed (boom/bust).

candidates.name: Jameis Winston
candidates.notes: 11/27 in relief (41%). Titans allow 74% comp and 13.5 QB pts/g. Nor'easter Sunday: 18 mph wind gusting 41, 83% rain. Volatile in every direction.

candidates.name: Bo Nix
candidates.notes: 66% comp; Rams allow 59% comp and 14 QB pts/g. Kinchens doubtful. Sunday night, 2.5-pt home dog.

candidates.name: Matthew Stafford
candidates.notes: Only 1 sack taken. Broncos allow 57% comp, 15 QB pts/g. Nacua doubtful. Wk1 line adjusted for Bennett's 3 att.

candidates.name: Kirk Cousins
candidates.notes: 6 TD but 3 INT (−15) on 59 att. Saints allow 67% comp, 18 QB pts/g, Emerson Q. Dome.

candidates.name: Lamar Jackson
candidates.notes: 10.0 Y/A, four 40+ completions. Cowboys secondary shredded (Durant, Hooker, Locke OUT), 2 sacks all season. Ronnie Stanley OUT. Rostered.

candidates.name: Brock Purdy
candidates.notes: 80% completions, 0 sacks, 50% first-down rate — the ideal profile for this scoring. Cardinals allow 111 rating. 8.5-pt favorite. Rostered.

candidates.name: Drake Maye
candidates.notes: 4 INT (−20) in two games, 15 FD. Jaguars allow 72% comp and 8 completions 20+, but 2 INT. Pressure faced 43.5%.

candidates.name: Justin Herbert
candidates.notes: 59% comp, 3 INT, 6 sacks, 45.5% pressure rate; two OL out. Bills allow 118 rating but 7 sacks. 7.25-pt dog. Risky.

candidates.name: Deshaun Watson
candidates.notes: 77% comp but 7 sacks. Panthers allow 64% comp, 5 sacks; Devin Lloyd OUT. 2.5-pt home dog.

candidates.name: Cam Ward
candidates.notes: 25% first-down rate is the worst here; 6.2 Y/A. Giants allow 108 rating, 1 sack, Burns Q — but the Nor'easter (18–41 mph wind, rain) hits this game.

candidates.name: Trevor Lawrence
candidates.notes: 67% comp, 40% FD rate, 3 sacks. Patriots allow 62.5% comp, 9 QB pts/g — tough. Schooler OUT.

candidates.name: Malik Willis
candidates.notes: 9 sacks (most in NFL), 58% comp. Chiefs allow 66% comp, 10.5 QB pts/g. 11-pt dog. Rushing is the only floor.

candidates.name: Sam Darnold
candidates.notes: Returns from glute injury (confirmed Fri). 2026 sample is 2 attempts → league prior. Commanders allow 137 rating, 7 TD / 0 INT, 33.5 QB pts/g (2nd worst). 7-pt favorite. Weather borderline (14 mph, 43% rain).

candidates.name: Kyler Murray
candidates.notes: Cleared concussion protocol, starts vs TB. 5 attempts of 2026 data → priors. Bucs allow 75% comp, 3 sacks. Slight road dog.

candidates.name: Jordan Love
candidates.notes: PLAYED Thu: 28/53 (25 incompletions = −25). 52% comp on the season is a disaster in this format despite 844 yds. Next: @TB Wk4.
